Recent Developments & News: On June 13, 2025, ITC finalized the acquisition of Sresta Natural Bioproducts Private Limited, the owner of the 24 Mantra Organic brand, for ₹472.50 crore. This acquisition marks a strategic move by ITC to bolster its presence in the organic packaged foods sector. The deal, which includes an upfront payment of ₹400 crore and a potential earn-out of up to ₹72.50 crore over the next 24 months, aligns with ITC’s ‘ITC Next’ strategy to build a future-ready portfolio. The acquisition is expected to enhance ITC’s market standing in the high-growth organic products space both domestically and internationally.
